page_title: BOU 1-0 CRY | Bournemouth v Crystal Palace 02/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' The whistle blows and Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) is booked for an infringement.

90+2' A cross from the side finds Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who unleashes a shot from the edge of the box. The ball is aimed to the left side of the goal, but the keeper makes a decent save to thwart the effort.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a substitution. Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) is replacing Adam Smith.
90' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Dominic Solanke will be replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
86' None of the Bournemouth players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
86' The substitution is prepared. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Adam Wharton.
86' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.

85' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
84' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

84' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Dean Henderson. Bournemouth force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
83' A pass into the penalty area from Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.
82' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

80' 1 - 0 Goal! Antoine Semenyo produces a great pass that finds Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the top right corner. 1:0.
70' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Jordan Ayew is replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
70' It is time for a substitution. David Ozoh (Crystal Palace) is on for Will Hughes.
69' Crystal Palace quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' Booking. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a caution from the referee.
68' Graham Scott blows for a foul after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

66' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Dean Henderson.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch so that Philip Billing can be given a rest.
63' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) replacing Dango Ouattara.
63' Graham Scott shows a yellow card to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
59' A yellow card for a tackle by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace). Graham Scott doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
52' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Philip Billing (Bournemouth), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
51' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
50' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card.
46' Half-time substitution. Andoni Iraola decided to make a change. Alex Scott is replaced by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
46' Graham Scott blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Crystal Palace due to an offside in the build-up play.
45+3' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Crystal Palace players aren’t happy.
45+2' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) finds the back of the net and gets on the scoresheet.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A poor mid-range free-kick by Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.

43' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Graham Scott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Bournemouth earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
42' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

38' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
38' Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.

37' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
37' Dean Henderson reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Philip Billing (Bournemouth) towards the bottom right corner.
35' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

35' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Neto pulls off an easy save.
28' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
26' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Neto is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
22' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
17' The game is interrupted now, Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
15' Bournemouth keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
7' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) leaps to collect the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Graham Scott.
